item.title: Application Problems
item.dc:creator: Rahul Singh
item.content:encoded:
Problem: Adhesion
CauseRemedies
Workpieces grounded insufficiently.Clean the hangers and hooks.
Powder resistance too low.Contact your powder manufacturer.
Poor grain size distribution.Contact your powder manufacturer.
Field strength too high.Change the current, and gun to object distance.
Powder is blown out of the corners and cavities by too much air
pressure.		Reduce the Total air pressure.
Too little penetration in the corners and cavities caused by too
high current or using of the wrong nozzles.

Reduce the current and use more suitable nozzles.
See also Nozzles.

Poor pre-treatment.Contact the supplier.
Wrong oven settings (too high, too low, curing time too long).Improve the oven settings.
Unsatisfactory powder quality.Contact the Powder supplier.
Change the powder. 
A too rapid stroke movement can break up the powder cloud.The stroke speed should not exceed 0.6 m/s – values
between 0.2 – 0.4 m/s are recommended.
Problem: Agglomeration formation
CauseRemedies
Grain distribution too fine.Contact the powder manufacturer.
Humidity in the powder due to incorrect storage.The powder must be dry and stored at the working temperature.
Sintering in the nozzles caused by a too high Total air pressure.Reduce the Total air pressure to 4 – 5 Nm3/h.
Poor fluidization in the powder container caused by humid compressed air or a clogged fluidizing plate.Check the compressed air for cleanliness, replace the fluidizing
plate.
Problem: Back Ionizer
CauseRemedies
The so-called back ionization is created when the powder coating is too thick.Reducing the high-voltage prevents back ionization; this however,
results in a reduction of the powder transfer rate. Back ionization
formation is also dependent on the temperature, and relative
humidity.  With very difficult powders air-conditioning of the
coating area may be necessary. See also “Orange peel”.
Problem: Booth
CauseRemedies
When powder suddenly escapes from a well set up booth, and the pressure monitoring of the exhaust system displays normal values, then the fault is usually to be found in the booth surroundings.The most frequent cause is draughts from open doors or windows
in the workshop (even far away from the booth).
Problem: Contamination
CauseRemedies
Unsatisfactory sieve machine.When a smaller mesh is not sufficient, fitting a sieve machine
with automatic contamination removal should be considered.
When the chain conveyer is not cleaned regularly or unsuitable grease/oil is used.Clean regularly, and when necessary, fit a hood.
When powder is blown into the oven.Check the workshop for air currents.
Powder residue in the oven.This can be prevented by regular cleaning.
Poorly cleaned recovery system.Clean regularly.
When dirty air is sucked into the booth or the oven.

Under certain conditions the coating plant must be separated
from the production areas.

When a number of booths are operated together, it can happen that cleaning is influenced.

In this case the booths must be separated further away from
each another.

Problem: Brightness/Gloss
CauseRemedies
When a powder comes out of the oven mat, then the specifications of the curing temperature of the special powder have not been observed.Always take into consideration the different curing temperatures
for the different powders
Problem: Discharging
CauseRemedies
In the hoses through charging the hoses by friction (spark generation) because the hose material has too little conductivity.Use original GEMA conductive powder hoses.
On the injector because of poor grounding.Use original GEMA conductive pneumatic hoses.
Between the object, and hook due to poor grounding.Strip the paint from the hangers and hooks.
Too little grounding on the manual gun.Do not wear rubber soles and/or gloves.
Using metallic powder.To avoid buildup of a conducting film, regular cleaning of the
nozzles and powder hoses is recommended. Nozzles for the
current generations of GEMA Guns GA02 / GA03  are suitable
for metallic powders. For the older generation of GEMA  guns:
Use the especial metallic nozzles
Problem: Economy

Cause: 
Next to the requirements in respect to chemical and mechanical resistance, color repetition, and surface structure, economical aspects also stand in the foreground for the end-user.

Remedies:
If you are putting new parts into your product range it will pay, in
most cases, to re-check the plant parameters. If the objects are
complicated, it will also pay to re-check the arrangement of the guns.

Problem: Edge build-up
CauseRemedies
Powder cloud too large.Operate with precisely aimed powder stream.                                        
Choose the right type of nozzle.  
Spacing between the objects too big.Use a gap control.
Shape of ObjectWork with PCC Mode
Use SuperCorona® ring
Problem: Flaking
CauseRemedies
Rough welded seams, and rust or water on the workpiece cause blisters on the coated surfaces, which can also flake off.   A correctly pre-treated workpiece is a prerequisite for a high quality
coating result.
Problem: Fluidizing
CauseRemedies
Fluidization of the powder has a great influence on the coating quality.In addition, with difficult powders we recommend to add a vibration
of  the powder hopper. Retrofitting a pneumatic or electric vibrating
table is simple.
Remark: GEMA  OPTICENTERS ARE NOT PREPARED TO WORK WITH
A VIBRATING TABLE.
Lumps appear in the fluidized powder, if the powder is stored too long or came into contact with temperatures over 35° C (95° F).Use new powder and check the storage conditions of the powder.
Poor fluidization of the powder can be caused by the fluidizing air being set too low.   Check the fluidizing air setting.
Problem: Gun arrangement
CauseRemedies
Definition of optimal gun arragementThe ideal gun arrangement depends on the booth, and its exhaust
air system. Booths with a CENTRAL EXHAUST AIR SYSTEM, and
QUICK COLOUR CHANGE SYSTEMS should be short. A vertical gun
arrangement is recommended here.
Problem: Gun function
CauseRemedies
An active powder gun uses not only current, but also draws voltage.Voltage and Current can be set independently on the Gun controls.
The adjusted setting is a limitation of the maximum values.
Problem: Level sensor
CauseRemedies
Grounding of the powder hopper is achieved with help of electrically conducting fluidizing hose. The grounding of the injectors is achieved analogously through a conductive supplementary air hose. This serves not only the safety of the personnel, but is a prerequisite that the electronics of the level sensor do not get damaged.Always use the original conductive GEMA hose
Problem: Maintenance work
CauseRemedies
The quality of your coating, and the length of the working life of the plant components depend greatly on the reliability of the maintenance of your plant. The following maintenance work must be carried out regularly: 
DAILY
  • Blow out the guns, and check for sintering
  • Check the setting of the spraying unit
  • Keep the gun conveying air pressure low
  • Check the injectors (caking / abrasion in the sleeve)
  • Blow out the injectors, and hoses
  • Clean the plant, recovery equipment, and surroundings
  • Check the suction resistance of the powder recovery unit
WEEKLY
  • Check the grounding
  • Check if the compressed air is clean, dry, and free from oil
  • Check the current performance of the gun
  • Check the powder hoses for sintering, and kinking
  • Check the stroke movement, and display
  • Check the filter system
Problem: Nozzles
CauseRemedies
How can I choose the right type of nozzle for my application?In order to obtain optimum coating results the choice of nozzle
must be adapted to the coating requirements:
 A flat jet nozzle produces an elliptical cross-section, and can be
well aligned to the object. It is used for a wide spectrum from
flat to  complex parts with cavities.
 The deflector plate creates a homogeneous powder cloud, which
slowly approaches the grounded workpiece. The cloud can only
be partially controlled and the penetration capability is poor.
It is used for flat parts, and tube inside coating.
Problem: "Orange peel"
CauseRemedies
When the powder coating on the object is too thick, an uneven surface is created.

If the coating thickness cannot be reduced, the use of a
SuperCorona® ring will effectively prevent the formation
of the “orange peel effect”. See also Back ionizer.

Problem: Picture frame effect
CauseRemedies
The so-called “picture frame effect” can result when using structured powders with Corona guns.This is effectively countered with the SuperCorona® set.
It is simple to fit to existing Gema powder guns.
To achieve optimum results after conversion the setting
parameters for high voltage, and powder output must be reset.
The PCC mode is another effective way to avoid
the picture frame effect.
Problem: "Pin pricks"
CauseRemedies
The use of silicon in the coating area is often the cause of a bad coating finish.Because all powders react “allergically” to silicon, it must never
be used in the coating area.
Problem: Pit formation
CauseRemedies
Pits form when gas escapes from the workpiece or contamination is not removed properly.Pitting is a pre-treatment fault, contact your supplier.
Problem: Powder container
CauseRemedies
The fluidizing air pressure or air volume is set too high.The fluidized powder should only “boil” lightly, but evenly.
In long term use, partial wear of the fluidizing plate can occur,
which must be compensated for by increasing the air volume.
In this case, the plate must be replaced.
If the powder container does not stand close enough to the booth, the venting can become blocked, overpressure can form in the container and powder can escape.The powder hopper should be as close as possible to the booth,
and connected to the booth with the shortest length of hose
possible. This venting hose must be cleaned daily.
Problem: Powder depositing on an object
CauseRemedies
Too large powder output volume per gun leads to a poor degree of powder separation.Reduce the powder output volume, and the conveyor speed.
Total air setting too high.Adjust the air volume to 4 – 5 Nm3.
Powder hoses too long.Shorten the powder hoses.
Incorrect gun nozzle.See Nozzles.
Relative Humidity over 80%The possible separation of the production area (with
air-conditioning) and workshop.
The proportion of large particles in the powder is too high.Contact your powder manufacturer.
Problem: Powder depositing on an object
CauseRemedies
Total air setting too low.The ideal air volume should be in the region of 4 – 5 Nm3.
Fine grain powder / powder with poor flow properties.Using a powder hopper with fluidizing air, and vibration will help.
Short term, high compressed air consumption can cause pressure fluctuations.Fitting a larger compressed air reservoir directly before a high
air consumption position will solve this problem.
A too small cross-section or too small radius in the powder hose line up.Radius must be at least 150 – 200 mm.
A poor ratio between fresh powder  and recovered powder.Use an automatic fresh powder feed.
Too high / low outputAdapt to the coating parameters.
Contaminated injectorsUse an automatic fresh powder feed.
Problem: Powder separation degree
CauseRemedies
A poor degree of powder separation is often caused by leaks in seals in the recovery system (after filter, cyclone, day container, sieve, powder container venting, powder hose connections, etc.)Look out for leaks in the system.
Check the exhaust air volume.

Problem: Powder separation degree of the cyclone
CauseRemedies
Cyclone cone is filling upCheck the recovery system .
Check function of level probe in the main powder hopper.                   
Insufficient exhaust airAdjust the exhaust air according to the fan curve.
Problem: Pulsing
CauseRemedies
Pulsation in the powder feed is created through incorrect setting of the total air or an incorrect powder feed relationship.Check the settings of the Powder output, and Total air. Depending
on the powder output, different Powder hose diameters are
available.
< 100gr/min = Ø 10/15 mm
100 – 200gr/min = 11/16mm
200 – 300gr/min = 12/18mm
Clogged after filterClean
Powder sintering in the side channel blowerClean
Clogged SieveClean or replace
Problem: Sieve problems
CauseRemedies
The powder hopper venting is too weak.Increase the air mover setting or if defective, replace.
Mesh width of the sieve is too small. Replace the sieve.
Waste bagThe waste bag of the rotary sieve machine should be slightly under-
pressure. When it is too inflated the Airmover must be set higher.
Problem: Stripe formation
CauseRemedies
In principle a mathematical connection exists between the conveying speed, the stroke speed, and the number of moving guns for the formation and avoidance of stripes on the workpiece.Check the run of the sinus program. If the time of the double
stroke of the gun is kept shorter than the time the reciprocator
requires for the object to pass through the spray band, no
stripes are formed.
Problem: Uneven coating
CauseRemedies
Grain size distribution of the powder is too coarse.Contact the powder manufacturer.
ContaminationContamination through “foreign” powder can be avoided by carefully
cleaning the equipment. Different powders should not be mixed.
Coating too thick or too thin.Adjust the powder output.
Workpieces too humid or too warm.Check the drying, and temperature of the workpieces.
Depositions on the nozzles.Maintenance!
Teardrops form when the powder ‘runs’.Check the curing parameter / temperature.
Problem: Yellowing
CauseRemedies
White powder reacts with too high curing temperatures or too long curing times with yellowing.   If pure white powder is used the powder manufacturer’s curing
instructions are to be followed exactly!

        • Check the powder hoses for sintering, and kinking<\/li><\/ul>
          • Check the stroke movement, and display<\/li><\/ul>
            • Check the filter system<\/li><\/ul><\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table>","_id":"65c995a"},{"tab_title":"Problem: Nozzles","tab_content":"
              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              How can I choose the right type of nozzle for my application?<\/td>In order to obtain optimum coating results the choice of nozzle
              must be adapted to the coating requirements:<\/td><\/tr>
              \u00a0<\/td>A flat jet nozzle produces an elliptical cross-section, and can be
              well aligned to the object. It is used for a wide spectrum from
              flat to\u00a0 complex parts with cavities.<\/td><\/tr>
              \u00a0<\/td>The deflector plate creates a homogeneous powder cloud, which
              slowly approaches the grounded workpiece. The cloud can only
              be partially controlled and the penetration capability is poor.
              It is used for flat parts, and tube inside coating.<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table><\/header>","_id":"b460557"},{"tab_title":"Problem: \"Orange peel\"","tab_content":"
              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              When the powder coating on the object is too thick, an uneven surface is created.<\/td>

              If the coating thickness cannot be reduced, the use of a
              SuperCorona\u00ae ring will effectively prevent the formation
              of the \u201corange peel effect\u201d. See also Back ionizer.<\/p><\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table><\/header>","_id":"690dbc7"},{"tab_title":"Problem: Picture frame effect","tab_content":"

              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              The so-called \u201cpicture frame effect\u201d can result when using structured powders with Corona guns.<\/td>This is effectively countered with the SuperCorona\u00ae set.
              It is simple to fit to existing Gema powder guns.
              To achieve optimum results after conversion the setting
              parameters for high voltage, and powder output must be reset.
              The PCC mode is another effective way to avoid
              the picture frame effect.<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table><\/header>","_id":"8de501e"},{"tab_title":"Problem: \"Pin pricks\"","tab_content":"
              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              The use of silicon in the coating area is often the cause of a bad coating finish.<\/td>Because all powders react \u201callergically\u201d to silicon, it must never
              be used in the coating area.<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table><\/header>","_id":"017d79a"},{"tab_title":"Problem: Pit formation","tab_content":"
              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              Pits form when gas escapes from the workpiece or contamination is not removed properly.<\/td>Pitting is a pre-treatment fault, contact your supplier.<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table><\/header>","_id":"ab1be17"},{"tab_title":"Problem: Powder container","tab_content":"
              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              The fluidizing air pressure or air volume is set too high.<\/td>The fluidized powder should only \u201cboil\u201d lightly, but evenly.
              In long term use, partial wear of the fluidizing plate can occur,
              which must be compensated for by increasing the air volume.
              In this case, the plate must be replaced.<\/td><\/tr>
              If the powder container does not stand close enough to the booth, the venting can become blocked, overpressure can form in the container and powder can escape.<\/td>The powder hopper should be as close as possible to the booth,
              and connected to the booth with the shortest length of hose
              possible. This venting hose must be cleaned daily.<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table><\/header>","_id":"933c034"},{"tab_title":"Problem: Powder depositing on an object","tab_content":"
              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              Too large powder output volume per gun leads to a poor degree of powder separation.<\/td>Reduce the powder output volume, and the conveyor speed.<\/td><\/tr>
              Total air setting too high.<\/td>Adjust the air volume to 4 - 5 Nm3<\/sup>.<\/td><\/tr>
              Powder hoses too long.<\/td>Shorten the powder hoses.<\/td><\/tr>
              Incorrect gun nozzle.<\/td>See Nozzles.<\/td><\/tr>
              Relative Humidity over 80%<\/td>The possible separation of the production area (with
              air-conditioning) and workshop.<\/td><\/tr>
              The proportion of large particles in the powder is too high.<\/td>Contact your powder manufacturer.<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table><\/header>","_id":"0837672"},{"tab_title":"Problem: Powder depositing on an object","tab_content":"
              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              Total air setting too low.<\/td>The ideal air volume should be in the region of 4 - 5 Nm3<\/sup>.<\/td><\/tr>
              Fine grain powder \/ powder with poor flow properties.<\/td>Using a powder hopper with fluidizing air, and vibration will help.<\/td><\/tr>
              Short term, high compressed air consumption can cause pressure fluctuations.<\/td>Fitting a larger compressed air reservoir directly before a high
              air consumption position will solve this problem.<\/td><\/tr>
              A too small cross-section or too small radius in the powder hose line up.<\/td>Radius must be at least 150 - 200 mm.<\/td><\/tr>
              A poor ratio between fresh powder\u00a0 and recovered powder.<\/td>Use an automatic fresh powder feed.<\/td><\/tr>
              Too high \/ low output<\/td>Adapt to the coating parameters.<\/td><\/tr>
              Contaminated injectors<\/td>Use an automatic fresh powder feed.<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table>","_id":"bc4d33c"},{"tab_title":"Problem: Powder separation degree","tab_content":"
              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              A poor degree of powder separation is often caused by leaks in seals in the recovery system (after filter, cyclone, day container, sieve, powder container venting, powder hose connections, etc.)<\/td>Look out for leaks in the system.
              Check the exhaust air volume.

              <\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table><\/header>","_id":"9545cde"},{"tab_title":"Problem: Powder separation degree of the cyclone","tab_content":"
              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              Cyclone cone is filling up<\/td>Check the recovery system .
              Check function of level probe in the main powder hopper.\u00a0 \u00a0 \u00a0 \u00a0 \u00a0\u00a0 \u00a0\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0<\/td><\/tr>
              Insufficient exhaust air<\/td>Adjust the exhaust air according to the fan curve.<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table>","_id":"77d0304"},{"tab_title":"Problem: Pulsing","tab_content":"
              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              Pulsation in the powder feed is created through incorrect setting of the total air or an incorrect powder feed relationship.<\/td>Check the settings of the Powder output, and Total air. Depending
              on the powder output, different Powder hose diameters are
              available.
              < 100gr\/min = \u00d8 10\/15 mm
              100 \u2013 200gr\/min = 11\/16mm
              200 \u2013 300gr\/min = 12\/18mm<\/td><\/tr>
              Clogged after filter<\/td>Clean<\/td><\/tr>
              Powder sintering in the side channel blower<\/td>Clean<\/td><\/tr>
              Clogged Sieve<\/td>Clean or replace<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table>","_id":"5755c96"},{"tab_title":"Problem: Sieve problems","tab_content":"
              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              The powder hopper venting is too weak.<\/td>Increase the air mover setting or if defective, replace.<\/td><\/tr>
              Mesh width of the sieve is too small.\u00a0<\/td>Replace the sieve.<\/td><\/tr>
              Waste bag<\/td>The waste bag of the rotary sieve machine should be slightly under-
              pressure. When it is too inflated the Airmover must be set higher.<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table>","_id":"3ed8d6c"},{"tab_title":"Problem: Stripe formation","tab_content":"
              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              In principle a mathematical connection exists between the conveying speed, the stroke speed, and the number of moving guns for the formation and avoidance of stripes on the workpiece.<\/td>Check the run of the sinus program. If the time of the double
              stroke of the gun is kept shorter than the time the reciprocator
              requires for the object to pass through the spray band, no
              stripes are formed.<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table><\/header>","_id":"5b22dbe"},{"tab_title":"Problem: Uneven coating","tab_content":"
              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              Grain size distribution of the powder is too coarse.<\/td>Contact the powder manufacturer.<\/td><\/tr>
              Contamination<\/td>Contamination through \u201cforeign\u201d powder can be avoided by carefully
              cleaning the equipment. Different powders should not be mixed.<\/td><\/tr>
              Coating too thick or too thin.<\/td>Adjust the powder output.<\/td><\/tr>
              Workpieces too humid or too warm.<\/td>Check the drying, and temperature of the workpieces.<\/td><\/tr>
              Depositions on the nozzles.<\/td>Maintenance!<\/td><\/tr>
              Teardrops form when the powder \u2018runs\u2019.<\/td>Check the curing parameter \/ temperature.<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table>","_id":"bdc80cb"},{"tab_title":"Problem: Yellowing","tab_content":"
              Cause<\/th>Remedies<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>
              White powder reacts with too high curing temperatures or too long curing times with yellowing.\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0<\/td>If pure white powder is used the powder manufacturer\u2019s curing
              instructions are to be followed exactly!<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table><\/header>","_id":"218052f"}],"border_color":"#000000","title_color":"#000000","content_color":"#000000"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"toggle"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Powder Coating Oven | Curing Oven
item.dc:creator: Rahul Singh
item.content:encoded:
Powder Coating Curing Oven

We Provide the best Powder coating oven / curing ovens manufacturer in the industry. Uniform heat distribution is the main key factor for our Oven, to make sure you get the best product output.

Enquiry form

Curing Oven

Curing Oven

We are the leading manufacturer of the Powder coating curing ovens. We are manufacturing batch type oven, Walk-in type oven, Conveyor type oven for the mass production. You can also choose from the heating mode Diesel fired, Gas fired or Electric oven.​

Variants available:

Batch Type
Powder Coating Oven

Batch type ovens are available in different size, we can customize Oven as per your product need. 

Conveyor Type
Powder Coating Oven

For the automated production, conveyor type ovens are required. We can design a customize Oven for your production line so you can maximize the output and increase the efficiency.

Why you should use VACSPL Curing Oven?

Value Added Coating Solution Pvt Ltd is a pioneer in the faculty of the best industrial powder coating oven. We are the best powder coating oven manufacturers that have good capacity and temperature.

We customize the powder coating booth and oven as per your plant demand, also we offer the complete setup so that you don’t have to go anywhere for anything. In this setup, we cover all the technical parameters, oven designing, and optimum manufacturing. The part of assembling and complete installing the oven is also done by us.

Custom Designs:

Our commercial powder coating oven is made and capable of any kind of powder for coating procedure. We provide the curing oven in almost all sizes and designs with maximum demanding temperature ranges.

The industrial powder coating oven designed by VACSPL is energy efficient with the demanded Dimensions (WxLxH). For our quality product, we are known to be the best in the powder coating industry just because of our past work and experience. We always believe in retentions and long term business relationship.

Firstly, we would like to tell you that, We use all the media of ovens like Gas, Diesel, and other electricity. Also, we also suggest you the best media as per your plant requirements. We also ensure that all the components used in making the industrial curing oven with the best-quality components using our best unique manufacturing methods.

Secondly, we like to tell you about the working of ovens. The working structure of curing ovens is simple. These ovens raise the temperature of the powder coated product and then it holds the temperature for the input time. After that time interval, it reduces the temperature and allowing the component to cool. The temperature and the holding period can be set as per the plant requirement.

So, finally at the end, here ate VACSPL, you can customize this oven for powder coating wheels, Almirah, cooler, automobile or any other component. 

The Main Features:

  • Uniform Temperature through out the input time interval
  • Best controlling technology
  • Easy installation due to Nut bolted construction.
  • Modular design and expandable construction for the future purpose.
  • Independent controlled fan for hot air.
  • Technology for minimum heat loss.
  • Best results in energy saving results
Checkout Phots of Oven

If you have any question, contact us.

Uniform and controlled heat is the main key for any oven, choose the best option for the best product finish, call us for more information, we would love to help you out.,

Call us

item.title: Powder Coating Gun
item.dc:creator: Rahul Singh
item.content:encoded:
POWDER COATING GUN

Order the best Coating Gun

Call us

Features

Perfect for frequent color change

It takes powder from Hopper, and it can be cleaned very easily, so very efficient for frequent color change.

quality

Ensures best quality by offering perfect powder fluidization even in even in challenging environment.

Productivity

Standard hopper size for continuous production ensures maximum production even at maximum powder transfer rate.

Call for Demo

Eapp Integration

The E-App enables predictive planning and scheduling of maintenance work, thus increasing plant availability. 

Application

Have all important application parameters completely under control via your mobile device!

Service

Long searches for user manuals are a thing of the past! The App offers direct access to the technical documentation of the system components.

Line Management

The Electrostatic App allows you to monitor the coating process. Productivity statistics and cost calculations are automatically generated for each job.

Setup

Configuration of the OptiFlex-Pro gun control is adjustable via the App with control individually or as part of a group.

Number says all.

+ 1 % Efficiency

Maximize your efficiency by 20 %. Its 110 KV charging will save your time and Powder as well.

1 Plants Installed

We have installed more than 71 manual  and automatic plants worldwide and counting.

1 % Support

We provide 100% support, during installation, during production, during maintenance. 

What people say?

Optiflex Pro is certainly a game changer, its app integration is phenomenal. Aman Ceo & Founder Aman Steels We were not sure about the product first, but when we saw the demo, used the machine, we knew "This is going to solve our problem". Sumit Head Of Sales , Jindal

Powder Coating Plant

We are the leading manufacturer of various types of Powder Coating Plant in India. Our firm specializes in any surface coatings with any kind of powders. Basically, we help you to provide with a state of the art Coating Plant, well worthy of your investment, more efficient, better production with decreasing time per job.

We basically believe in the client requirement, yes we suggest it in a better way but in the end, it will be designed as per your plant capacity.

With the non-comparable capacity, we are the leading manufacturer of powder coating plants and various machines in India. We have planted the powder coating plant in almost every city of India whether it is of Almirah, Cooler, Automobiles, manufacturing machines, or any other industrial parts.

We believe that if you want to set up a Powder Coating Plant then various parameters must be kept in mind such as the sizes and shapes of the components you want to coat, coating quality required by your client and thickness of paint material required, the production speed (number of jobs /day or hour), space available for plant and many more factors at the time of quality discussion.

Our range of Coating Plant facility includes basic manual Plant to conveyorised automatic Plant with auto reciprocators and auto guns. Our advanced technology will help you to get better results in durability, speed, exact calculation. It basically creates the data that you can compare with the future data to make the best progress report. It will help you to make better strategies as well.

 Our powder recovery technology offers to work in all denominations. It comes from the basic mono cyclone to multi cyclones and finally cartridge recovery system as well.

The booths are offered in SS, CRCA-Powder Coated as per agreement. Their basic purpose is to collect all the over-sprayed powder that didn’t interact with the component that throws off the powder coating gun.

Also, the recovery booths are of various types depending upon their increased efficiency. They are single cyclone, multi-cyclone, and cartridge type as well. It always deepens on your requirements.

Advantages / Why you should go for a Powder Coating plant?

  • Energy-Efficient Designs / Low Power Consumption
  • Remote System is available for best controlling from anywhere
  • Minimum Operating Costing
  • Best in Function with Simple Designs
  • Advanced and Optimum Powder Recovery Technology
  • Best Powder Management System
  • Automatic Equipment for better results
  • No Primer needed
  • Reduced overspray losses and maximum saving of powder
  • Labour costs are reduced.
  • The plant occupies less space
  • No flameproof equipment needed

FEATURES:

  • Various Denominations of ovens can be offered as per the budget and designs.
  • Remotely Controlled by anywhere. You can control the plant even from your office.
  • Direct Gas Type - c/w Imported Burner and Heat Exchanger
  • Indirect Type of Heating System as per requirement
  • Suitable for "n" number of Jobs/day
  • Semi and fully automatic plant with PLC controlled system
  • Pre Treatment designed are dip type 5-9 tanks made of MS Tanks
  • Material handling of Overhead Conveyor to PLC Controlled Transporter
  • Automatic Electrical Panel and Wiring
  • Execute the project on a turnkey basis

item.title: Support
item.dc:creator: Rahul Singh
item.content:encoded:
Oven Profiling (TTR)

With our years of experience & in depth knowledge in this field, we are engaged in offering a quality-assured array of Oven Temperature Profiling Service. 

Gloss Testing

We are also providing gloss testing, you can test the finish of the coating to ensure you are getting quality as needed.

Cross Adhesion Testing

To assure quality and to measure the resistance of the coating.

. 

Impact Testing

Want to check strength of your coating?

Impact Testing is one of the way to check the strength of the coating, which determines the life of the coating on the surface.

Dry Film Thickness Testing

item.title: Why you should choose Optiflex Pro?
item.dc:creator: Inderjeet Singh
item.content:encoded:
Optiflex Pro is the revolution in the powder coating industry. It is the most advanced in features. It is designed in a way to increase the plant efficiency to more than 20%.

OptiFlex Pro closed hopper protects powder from the ambient and gently fluidizes it for an ideal powder delivery.

Gema’s PowerBoost® technology your OptiSelect manual gun can now deliver 110 kV high voltage.

 

This outstanding feature gives you extra power to increase transfer efficiency, charge more powder and finish your coating job quicker. All this without compromising the safety of your operators and of your line, thanks to Gema’s advanced protection technology.

Reasons to opt for Optiflex Pro :

  • Robust and durable design
  • The ergonomic and light-weight gun is well-balanced in the hand
  • Enables you to coat efficiently and faster
  • PowerBoost® - Safe technology for more power performance
  • The integrated cleaning of the powder conveying components can be enhanced by the optional PowerClean™ module
  • The latest generation of nozzles ensures an excellent powder distribution and penetration

  • The newly developed PowerBoost technology of the OptiFlex Pro series offers with the 110 kV the highest powder charging capacity in the powder coating industry while complying with safety regulations.
  • The operator benefits from an outstanding coating performance.
  • The new feature completes the proven high-voltage functionalities, such as PCC mode, presettings and individual coating programs and extends the application range significantly.

OptiStar® 4.0

  • Precise Charge Control Mode (PCC) for high-quality coating tasks
  • The intuitive display makes it easy for any user to set and program the optimal parameters. 
  • The result is a perfect coating quality that can be reproduced at any time.
  • Digital Valve Control Technology (DVC) for precise powder delivery
  • Electrostatic App (E-App) for transparency of the coating

Electrostatic App (Gema E-App)

  • The new features of OptiFlex Pro also give you a technological edge.
  • The Electrostatic App (E-App) with the integrated line management functions and additional service features make the coating process transparent and better controllable.
  • Important data of your application are always at hand and can be easily exported for further usage.

To revolutionise your production, opt for Optiflex Pro, to know more about this, Contact us or drop an enquiry

item.title: Want to maximise your production, Automatic Booth Systems is the solution
item.dc:creator: Inderjeet Singh
item.content:encoded:
Quick color change or single color, manual or automatic, organic, or enamel powder, Gema has the right solution for you.

Compact and flexible single channel booth design:

A versatile concept combining pre/post touch up and a large automatic application area in a compact design, ideal for easy and quick cleaning.

Non-conductive walls for cleaner operation

Magic Systems remain clean during operation: the non-conductive plastic walls and the self-cleaning floor prevent powder accumulations.

Non-conductive walls: how do they work?

  • Traditional sheet metal booth walls are conductive and attract charged powder particles that accumulate in thick layers on their surface.
  • Magic Systems’ plastic sandwich walls are non-conductive and do not attract powder.
  • Only a small amount of powder particles can deposit on the non-conductive walls. The charge of the deposited particles creates an electric field that repels powder.

Air-knives: how do they work?

  • Air-knives are integrated into the sidewalls of the Magic Systems’ floor.
  • During operation and cleaning air blasts are periodically released by the air knives.
  • The air blasts remove the powder accumulated on the booth floor and push it to the extraction and recovery system.
  • The booth floor remains clean, with just a minimum amount of powder.

Easy and quick color change:

  • Magic Systems have very low powder accumulation, therefore the operator can clean the walls and the floor easily and quickly with an air lance.
  • The risks to blow powder out of the booth and to contaminate the ambient are minimized.
  • The risk of color contamination due to improper booth cleaning is also minimized.
  • The color change is easy, quick, and contamination-free.

EquiFlow: an intelligent airflow distribution

The patented EquiFlow technology ensures a powerful air extraction at the booth openings and a gentle airflow in the automatic section.

EquiFlow: how does it work?

● The “H” shaped air extraction slot on the booth floor creates an ideal airflow distribution. o 40% air extraction in the automatic coating area o 2 x 30% air extraction at entrance / exit, close to the touch up stations ● The EquiFlow Intellectual Property is protected by Gema

Ideal airflow distribution

• The EquiFlow Technology creates ideal working conditions in each section of the powder coating booth • A smooth and homogeneous airflow in the central area ensures ideal powder application conditions for automatic coating. • A vigorous airflow at the entrance / exit avoids powder escaping the booth and creates optimal working conditions for the touch -up operators.

Easy color change

● Single channel concept reduces the cleaning efforts. ● Simple and easy to clean channel geometry. ● Cleaning tool provided for easy and accurate channel cleaning. ● Automatic air -knives in the booth floor prevent powder accumulations ● A stable walk-in booth floor allows easy cleaning of the walls of the booth.

Best performance for coating large parts

A versatile range of booths systems, specially designed to ensure optimal coating performance and good color change time even with large parts.

A complete range of solutions for every need

Magic Systems are easy to customize in booth dimensions, air volume, number and position of guns and touch-up stations.

Automated color change process

With Gema Magic Systems the color change process is easy and quick, even with just one operator.

Non-conductive walls for cleaner operation

Magic Systems remain clean during operation: the non-conductive plastic walls and the self-cleaning floor prevent powder accumulations.

Air-knives: how do they work?

• Air-knives are integrated in the sidewalls of the Magic Systems’ floor. • During operation and cleaning air blasts are periodically released by the air knives. • The air blasts remove the powder accumulated on the booth floor and push it to the extraction and recovery system. • The booth floor remains clean, with just a minimum amount of powder.

Best guns for color change

The optimized design, the smooth material and the innovative nozzles make Gema guns the best for color change.  

Ideal design of the powder path

● The inside diameter remains constant and the transition between the different parts of the gun is very smooth. ● These features prevent powder depositions inside the gun and facilitate the cleaning procedures. Result: ● Straight, deposition-free path ● Constant powder output

item.title: Manual Powder Coating Gun is loaded with amazing technology, to provide you the best finish.
item.dc:creator: Inderjeet Singh
item.content:encoded:
A wide variety of solutions for the electrostatic manual coating to satisfy even the most challenging application requirements.

Easy and automated color change process

All components in contact with powder are cleaned quickly and automatically while the operator is replacing the powder box.

Power: Maximum coating performance

The newly developed PowerBoost technology of the OptiFlex Pro series offers with the 110 kV the highest powder charging capacity in the powder coating industry while complying with safety regulations.
The operator benefits from an outstanding coating performance.

Quality: Best application results

With OptiFlex Pro you coat extremely efficiently and with consistently high quality. The PCC (Precise Charge Control) mode regulates the spray current even in the lowest ampere ranges (0-10 μA) with the highest accuracy. This prevents overcharging of even the most demanding powders such as metallic powder and ensures the highest quality in thick film and multi-layer applications and recess areas.

Control: Master the application!

The new features of OptiFlex Pro also give you a technological edge. The Electrostatic App (E-App) with the integrated line management functions and service features make the coating process transparent and better controllable.

More Power Performance

Thanks to Gema’s PowerBoost® technology manual gun can now deliver 110 kV high voltage! This outstanding feature gives you extra power to increase transfer efficiency, charge more powder and finish your coating job quicker. All this without compromising the safety of your operators and of your line, thanks to Gema’s advanced protection technology.

PowerBoost: how does it work?

The high-performance technology is based on the combination of three essential components: ● OptiStar 4.0 advanced software for charging process and compliance with safety regulation ● OptiSelect Pro high performance cascade ● NF40 PowerBoost nozzle special design for more efficient charging

NF40 PowerBoost Nozzle

PowerBoost Nozzle characteristics: ● Cloud soft could wide brush spray pattern >60° ● Material non stick high quality materials (PTFE / ETFE / PP) ● Application ideal for large parts and fast coating

PowerBoost: Maximum Coating Performance

PowerBoost: activating ● Direct switch on manual gun OptiSelect Pro ● On OptiStar 4.0 by selecting spray voltage above 100kV ● E-App by typing spray voltage above 100kV

Digital Valve Technology (DVC)

Thanks to the patented DVC technology, Gema’s OptiStar gun controls offer precise and reproducible powder output regulations and improve the film thickness consistency

DVC technology: how does it work?

  • Digital Valve Control (DVC) is the technology used in the OptiStar gun controls.
  •  The flow of compressed air to the OptiFlow injector is regulated by motor-driven valves.

The first choice for efficient manual coating

The OptiSelect Pro gun is characterised by a very robust and durable design. The ergonomic gun lies balanced in the hand, has a good grip and enables you to coat efficiently and faster.

PowerClean for fastest color changes

PowerClean™ efficiently cleans the entire powder path from the injector to the gun tip. This improves performance when processing difficult powders and facilitates color change.

Unsurpassed Gema reliability

The famous Gema guns' reliability is based on more than 50 years of experience in powder coating and on the high Swiss quality standards. OptiFlex Pro is using a compact setup to deliver the powder to a standard OptiSelect gun.

Flexible with vertical or horizontal guns arrangement

Designed for smooth operation

These reciprocators is equipped with an advanced synchronized motor for highest efficiency during continuous operation.'

Easy service and great reliability

The reciprocators require only minimum maintenance that can be completed easily and quickly.

Powerful and reliable

Main Features Overview:

High power for many guns

Reciprocators have a high load capacity, they can carry a high number of guns with extreme precision and high reliability.

Flexible with vertical or horizontal guns arrangement

These reciprocator is designed for short or long stroke operation. The guns can be mounted in horizontal or vertical arrangement.

Reciprocator version for a high loading capacity

Capable to carry up to 100kg.

Designed for smooth operation

The frequency converter controlled AC-Motor drive, the long lasting thooth-belt and the robust design ensure a quiet operation and great stability.

Easy service and great reliability

The reciprocator is designed for short or long stroke operation. The guns can be mounted in horizontal or vertical arrangement.

Automatic speed adjustment to conveyor speed

The MagicControls track the conveyor speed and automatically adjust the reciprocator to the ideal speed for perfect sinus and great coating results.

Vertical reciprocator: for extreme high loading capacity

Extreme powerful reciprocator with space-saving design, very precise movements and easy programming.

Extreme high loading capacity

Reciprocators have a high load capacity up to 100 kg. They can carry a high number of guns and ensure very precise gun positioning and reliable operation.

Space-saving guns arrangement

The reciprocator is designed for short or long stroke operation. The guns can be mounted in horizontal or vertical arrangement.

Gun axis and vertical reciprocator arrangement

This combination guarantees perfect coating results for complex application demands and difficult part geometries.

YT synchronizing axis

XT horizontal axis

It moves a ZA vertical reciprocator in and out of the booth adapting to the part width.  Ideal solution also for guns outside cleaning at color change.

YT synchronizing axis

It moves a ZA reciprocator parallel to the parts, synchronized with the conveyor speed. Ideal for inside coating and other difficult applications.

U in-out axis

The U axis moves 1 or 2 automatic guns in-out. It is ideal for guns positioning and inside coating.

AR rotating axis

This axis can turn 1 or 2 guns over a fixed radius. It is ideal to coat round shaped objects such as wheels or loading openings of washing machines.

SR tilting axis

This axis can tilt a ZA reciprocator in-out of the booth. It is ideal to achieve a uniform coating on inclined surfaces.

Vertical reciprocator: for extreme high loading capacity

Extreme high loading capacity

Reciprocators have a high load capacity up to 100 kg. They can carry a high number of guns and ensure very precise gun positioning and reliable operation.

Space-saving guns arrangement

The reciprocator is designed for short or long stroke operation. The guns can be mounted in horizontal or vertical arrangement.

Gun axis and vertical reciprocator arrangement

This combination guarantees perfect coating results for complex application demands and difficult part geometries.

Designed for smooth operation

The frequency converter controlled AC-Motor drive, the long lasting thooth-belt and the robust design ensure a quiet operation and great stability.

Easy service and great reliability

The reciprocators require only minimum maintenance that can be completed easily and quickly.

item.title: Want to paint different colors on the product, Don't worry we got you covered
item.dc:creator: Inderjeet Singh
item.content:encoded:
Gema Powder Coating Quick Color Change Booth: Gema Powder Coating booth are designed in such a way, that they are at maximum performance all the time and when you need to change the color, You can do it very quick. We are going to explain about the features of the Quick color change booth. Magic Systems are easy to customize in booth dimensions, air volume, number and position of guns and touch-up stations.
  • Efficient powder application
  • Sieving and fresh powder feed
  • Robust and reliable for every need
Lets Check the Powder Flow :
  • From the feed station  the powder is transported to the electrostatic guns that charge it and apply it on the parts.
  • The final filter separates the overspray powder from the extraction air.
  • A recovery pump transports the powder to the sieving station where powder is cleaned from contaminants and returns to the powder feed station.
  • The system can be provided with various automatic fresh powder feed solutions
Ideal solution for every customer’s needs:
  • EquiFlow technology can be used in different layouts to accommodate every customer’s needs
  • Great performance, robustness and easy maintenance in every solution
  • MagicCylinder EquiFlow, the unique round-booth solution

item.title: Pollution Free Powder Coating Booth, Zero Wastage, Zero Pollution, Max Efficiency
item.dc:creator: Inderjeet Singh
item.content:encoded:
Pollution free powder coating booths are most efficient, as there is no wastage, neither causing any issue to the environment. These are build as per the industry standards so you can have the best product finish with minimum wastage.

No powder escaping the booth: Gema recovery systems are designed according to the strictest safety regulations and the specific requirements of each plant.

After Filter units for MonoCyclones: These filters are installed after the cyclones. They use self cleaning cartridges and reach over 99.99% separation efficiency. Powder from the filter can be imediately recirculated to the guns.

Filter Units for manual and small automatic lines: These reliable filter units are equipped with conical cartridges and use a manually activated jet cleaning system

item.title: Check out the Powder Coating Process
item.dc:creator: Inderjeet Singh
item.content:encoded:
Powder coating process is the method that is for making the final product. It is industrial process to paint the metals of other related products. Basically in this process we need some instruments and materials. Please find the process points below.

The main segment of Powder Coating Plant.

  • PT Line - Cleaning of product
  • Powder Coating Booth
  • Coating Oven
  • Powder Coating Gun
Let's say, our product is manufactured and ready to coat. We will start with PT lines/ Pre Treatment line. Typically, adhesion between a paint coating and steel sheet is not very good. That's why in Powder coating process, it is recommended to  apply some type of intermediate layer, a pretreatment, to develop good long-term performance. Not only does the pretreatment improve the mechanical adhesion between the paint and the coating, but it also improves the resistance to blistering and loss of paint adhesion during exposure to corrosive environments.

Steps are:

  1. Hot Water Rinse
  2. Knock-off-Degrease
  3. Degrease
  4. Water Rinse 
  5. Water Rinse
  6. Activation
  7. Phosphating
  8. Rinse
  9. Drying
After Pretreatment, out product is ready for powder coating, now we will take our  product to the Powder Coating Booth. With the help of manual gun or reciprocators we will apply charged powder on the surface, let's see how.

item.title: Gema Powder Coating Gun vs Local Powder Coating Guns
item.dc:creator: Inderjeet Singh
item.content:encoded:
Why You Should Choose Gema Powder Coating Guns over Local Guns?

Gema has a great industry reputation for the durability in Powder Coating Industry of their powder coating guns, and the Optiflex Pro will last you for years. The warranty is also the best in the coating gun industry and this shows Gema’s trust in their Guns. However, the replacement parts also have a big market so there will not be any difficulty in using these Gema machines. book a demo Gema Guns Vs Local Guns There is a variety of companies out there who are manufacturing Powder Coating Machines. Some Branded company like Gema and also a Local Manufacturer are providing Powder Coating machines like Gun, Powder Coating Booth, Plants, Ovens. The main thing is that everyone is not working on quality, efficiency and productivity of their clients. Today we will discuss the Manual Powder Coating Gun of Both the Branded Company Gema and the Local manufacturers. There are some major features that make Gema differ from any of the machines in Powder coating industry. All of the features with comparison are listed below.

1. DVC (Digital Valve Control Technology)

  • Gema provides Free DVC forever after the warranty period as well. But in the case of Local Guns, they don’t provide this feature.
  • In other guns, they charge you for DVC after the warranty period.
  • In Gema guns, you can control all parameters digitally, so the result will be more accurate. But in the case of local guns, you can not get the exact figures.

2. Auto-Lock Fluidizing Air Supply when Gun on Cradle

  • Gema Guns have Auto-Lock Fluidizing Air Supply when Gun on Cradle. So, when the gun is not in operation the auto-lock will stop the supply.
  • In the case of Local guns, this feature is not available

3. Powder output

  • In Gema, Guns Powder output control is provided on the Gun’s handle so that you do not have to go again and again on the machine for changing the output. So it helps to reduce time in coating and results in fast production.
  • But in the case of other Local guns, the Powder control is provided on the machine side, in it, you have to go to the machine every time and it takes time results Slow the production and increasing time.

4. Coating Programme

  • Gema Powder Coating Guns have 3 preset programs and 20 manual programs available.
  • It can also be set according to your requirement and coating procedure.
  • There is no preset program available in Local Guns.

5. Integrated 110 KV high voltage cascade

  • It is recorded and tested that Gema guns have the highest transfer efficiency of power to the components.
  • It saves 15% of power or more than this against local Guns.
  • In the case of local guns, it is Barrel (it's a maximum 50-60 Kv).

6. Auto-cleaning Mode

  • In Gema Guns, the equipment can be cleaned by a button from Pump to Gun within 10 Seconds (through air blast)
  • It is the best example of time-saving when colour change. The main time is reduced hence the productivity is improved of the plant.
  • Very successful in case of multicolour powder coating as well
  • In the case of Local Guns, you need to follow the old procedure that is manual cleaning. It takes time and slows the productivity of the plant. It results in losses of revenue.

7. Trigger Counter

  • Because it is an advanced gun so it is having some more important features that don’t available in other guns. The total hours of Gun trigger time are automatically stored in the Control Unit.
  • By this, you can predict the maintenance schedule of the machine. Also, it will help you to get the data by which you can predict your plant output that how many jobs are done at what time.
  • In local guns Guns, this feature is not available.

8. Monitoring of wearing parts

  • In Gema Guns, Wearing parts can Be Monitor through update the value in Contol Unit.
  • In local guns, it only depends on the operator. So you can not monitor it at all.

9. PCC mode (precise charge control)

  • This is only available in Gema Guns.
  • It reduces the Faraday effect. The result is you can have a smooth coating in every product & every powder (i.e. metallic & texture). You don’t have to compromise efficiency and quality.
  • Not Available in Local powder coating guns.

10. Error Diagnosis Feature

  • Gema provides an awesome technology-based Powder Coating Machine, so here it is not the end of the features, there is also one of the main features that will win your heart. If there is an internal problem that occurs in Machine, the Display error code is provided to identify the exact problem.
  • So, you don’t need any serviceman to find the problem.
  • It's helpful for resolve within a short time
After carefully doing the comparison, it results that if you want to work on efficiency, quality, productivity and save you time then you need these features in your powder coating machine. So, the choice of Gema will do this all for you. For maximum versatility, For high-end performance, For longevity or If you are planning on expansion, Gema Guns are the best option. No matter which gun you choose from any of the manufacturers, we’ve sure that if you choose Gema then it will provide you with high-quality equipment that will produce a finish you and your customers can be proud of. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W36h3ci-HO8

Manual Powder Coating Machine

item.title: How much does it powder coating Plant setup cost in India
item.dc:creator: Inderjeet Singh
item.content:encoded:
If you just want to know where You can find the cheapest powder coating plant setup cost then here is the solution for you.

The powder coating plant setup cost is totally dependent on per day production required by the client. So how can you say that this is the cheapest plant or this is the expensive plant without knowing the production? So the manual powder coating machine price or fully automatic powder coating plant price depends on some factors.

Type of Powder Coating Plants

Then you need to check what kind of powder coating plant you want. Basically, there are three types of powder coating lines.
  1. Manual powder coating Plant
  2. Semi Automatic-Conveyorised Powder Coating Plant
  3. Fully automatic conveyorised powder coating plant
Here, we (Value Added Coating Solution Pvt Ltd) help you to choose the best suitable line for the client as per capacity and component. You can call us directly if you want us to do the calculation for you. Don't worry, we do not charge you for it. Also, we do not believe in sales calls, so you won't be having any unnecessary calls from outside.

Contact Details:

  • Mr. Harish Sharma: +91- 9811846214
  • Mr. Lalit Tayal: +91- 9811357749
  • info@coating-solution.com
  • Get a Call Back 

How much does a powder coating system cost?

Factors affect Costing (Cheap or Expensive)

There are some more factors after production (number of components per day) on which the costing depends. So firstly you need to list some points:
  1. How many components do you want to coat per day?
  2. For how many hours the plant is running
  3. What is the size of your component?
  4. What is the size of the area where you want to set up your plant?
We give you the format of the manual that is having all the points listed so that you have everything on the paper. (FREE)

Costing in Design, It really affects

Now after you have the type of component, production per day, plant hours, and your plant area now you need a company to design your powder coating line. There are so many factors that are considered when we are designing your powder coating line.

Conveyor Load:

Firstly, we need to check the conveyor load. That totally depends on the weight of the component. And if you need multiple components in parallel.

The number of PT Line:

Now we need to study your component opt product. What is the material? How fine do you want the quality coating? Now we calculate the number of  PT processes required for your component.

Drying Oven | Powder Coating Plant Setup Cost

  • Now you need a drying oven to dry your component after the PT process.
  • In the case of a drying oven, you need to check the length of the conveyor you want in it. And for how long do you want a component in it like. It is like 18 meters 15 or 20 depending on the component and production.
  • The oven size and the conveyor length will add to the costing.

Powder Coating Booth | Powder Coating Plant Setup Cost

After this, your component will move to your booth where the powder coating starts.
  • In that case, you need to check how many components you want to coat at a time. 
  • If a component is small like you are coating Aluminium sections then you can have multiple Aluminium sections at a time.
  • But if you are coating a large product like almirah then you need to check how many almirahs do you want to coat at a time. if you want 3 almirahs at a time in the booth that means you need to increase or decrease your both sizes.
  • According to this data, the booth will be designed and the cost will decrease or increase.

Curing Oven:

  • Then finally the component will move to the curing oven where you need to keep your component dry at a fixed temperature.
  • The cost of the oven depends on the size and the temperature you want. Also, there are various types of Ovens. 
  • You need to choose the one that is suitable for you as per costing and the component finishing.
We can do all the calculations for you for free and let you know the cheapest price of the powder coating line. Feel free to call us at any time.  Value Added Coating Solution Pvt Ltd Office: 515, Devika Tower, Chander Nagar, Ghaziabad, 201010 Manufacturing: K-288, Site-V, Surajpur Industrial Area Kasna, Greater Noida (U.P.)- 201310 +91- 9811846214 | +91- 9811357749 | info@coating-solution.com Follow us: Facebook | Instagram | Youtube

item.dc:creator: Inderjeet Singh
item.content:encoded:
Types of Powder Coating Finish:

There are three major categories of powder coating.

1. Thermoplastics

  • Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC)
  • Polyolefin
  • Polyester

2. Thermosets

  • Epoxy
  • Epoxy-Polyester Hybrid
  • Acrylic
  • Silicon-Based Powders

3. UV Curable Powder Coats

1. Thermoplastics:

Thermoplastics are synthetic materials that can be formed multiple times. The metal's surface is first heated to the desired temperature. The successive cooling process then causes the coating to harden and gain strength. They are the thick and resilient coatings. They provide excellent corrosion protection and weathering resistance. Thermoplastic coatings are functional coatings and is usually a decorative and thin-film coating

  • Poly Vinyl Chloride:

PVC is available in several powder forms (electrostatic spray and fluidized bed). Electrostatic spray is used to apply PVC coatings up to 8 mil thick and fluidized bed applications can apply PVC between the range 8-25 mil thick. In either case, a liquid primer must be applied to the substrate in order to obtain complete adhesion. If the PVC is applied without a primer, it can be cut and peeled from the substrate much like stripping wire of insulation. As PVC is a thermoplastic organic coating, it isn’t cured with heat; it is only flowed to obtain some smoothness and form the coating. PVC powder coatings are good for various forms of insulation.

  • Polyolefin:

Polyolefinic powder coatings are resistant to a variety of adverse environments. It gives a smooth surface and good adhesion properties. Polyolefin coatings are used on lab equipment components. Solvent resistance property is good when compared to all common solvents used in industry. Only very strong oxidizing agents, such as will attack the coatings at room temperature.

  • Polyesters

Polyester powder coating is a long-term, durable solution when compared to traditional painting methods. This is mostly used in metals. Polyesters are the most commonly used powder coat and offer great value for money. It provides great flexibility, impact resistance, good chemical and mechanical resistance. the main advantage of polyesters is the huge choice of colours, gloss levels and special effects they’re available in. It is also cost-effective to get the desired colour and finish.

2. Thermoset:

This type of coatings will chemically react during baking to form a polymer network that is much more resistant to a coating breakdown. Thermosetting powders can be applied onto coil, wires, and screen mesh by being sprayed. thermosetting coatings do not re-melt when they are cooled after heat is re-applied. Thermosets are more resistant to high temperature when compared to thermoplastics.it gives excellent aesthetic appearance, dimensional stability and also cost-effective.

  • Epoxy:

Epoxy is an organic compound. It is made up of carbon chains that are linked to other elements, such as hydrogen, nitrogen or oxygen. Epoxy powder coating is a hard coating which provides very good adhesion, flexibility and chemical resistance. Epoxy coating is ideal for use as a functional coating for surface protection for a variety of applications. It is available in a wide range of colours with a smooth or textured finish but it is not recommended for exposed, open-air environments or situations where exposure to ultraviolet radiance will cause chalking.

  • Epoxy-Polyester Hybrid:

Epoxies and Polyester are mixed together to form hybrids. This is one of the widely used powder coating. It is well known for its hardness and have the best chemical and corrosion resistance of all available powders. The main advantage of this type of powder is good electrostatic spray characteristics.it can be applied with excellent transfer efficiency and shows good penetration.

  • Acrylic:

Acrylic resins are the base for highest quality powder coating technologies. Acrylics can offer excellent chemical resistance, superior exterior durability, chemical resistance and outstanding smoothness especially for vehicle application.it is well known for its remarkable resistance to various environmental conditions, cleaning agents, and even gasoline spills. But the disadvantage in this powder is that it is high in cost and there can be compatibility issues. Generally, lower-end manufacturers do not use acrylic powders.

  • Silicon Based Powders:

The silicon-based powder is being in use over decades for high performance liquid coating. In this process, silicon resins are synthesized in solvents then stripped and flaked.it will allow formulators to create differentiated, high-performance protective and decorative coatings. It provides high performances to a wide variety of products such as synthetic resins, rubbers, paints, inks and coating materials by adding to them.

3. UV Curable Powder Coat:

Powder coatings cured with UV light offer increased benefits over thermosetting coatings such as faster curing cycles with lower temperature requirements. UV formulations are liquid monomers and oligomers mixed with a small percent of photo initiators, and then exposed to UV energy. UV cured powder will melt within minutes when reaching a temperature 110 °C and 130 °C. UV curable coatings were first used as a better alternative to solvent-based products.it has great properties such as scratch and chemical resistance, adhesion and bond strength.

Matte finish

Matte finish surface is a non reflective finish applied to an object or vehicle. It usually have a roughened, dull, and unpolished look that reflects scattered light in the space and it is non-glossy. Because of that reason, they are excellent for hiding any surface imperfections. Matte finishes have a lot of pigment, making them quick and easy to apply to more extensive surfaces. Most commonly used on cars.

 

Matte finish is the process of overlaying different or the same colours of paint and applying a clear coat on the top of them all. It is easier to view from all angles and in all kinds of light because the surface does not easily reflect light Matte looks more handmade and artistic professional look.

Matte coating gives a diffused sheen, which boosts the contrast  and offers a smoother presentation than gives a classy look to an object. But is also sensible to chips and scratches. It also requires extensive care .

item.title: Powder Coating and Liquid Painting: Why Powder Reigns Supreme
item.dc:creator: info@coating-solution.com
item.content:encoded:
At Value Added Coating Solution Private Limited, we pride ourselves on providing top-tier Powder Coating Plants and Systems that set the benchmark for quality and efficiency. Powder coating has gained immense popularity over traditional wet paint or liquid painting, thanks to its superior benefits when check the comparison Powder Coating vs Liquid Painting.

Powder Coating vs Liquid Painting: The Clear Choice

One of the most common questions is, "Is powder coating better than wet paint?" or "What is the difference between powder coating and liquid painting?" This article explores why powder coating is the superior choice.

10 Key Benefits of Powder Coating

1. Durability and Longevity

Powder coating creates a thick, hard finish that’s more durable than liquid paint. It resists chipping, scratching, fading, and wear, making it perfect for high-traffic areas and harsh environmental conditions.

2. Environmental Friendliness

Powder coating is a greener alternative to liquid painting. Unlike traditional paints, powder coating releases negligible volatile organic compounds (VOCs), contributing to a safer environment and healthier workplaces.

3. Efficiency and Cost-Effectiveness

The powder coating process minimizes waste through overspray recovery and reuse. This efficiency reduces costs over time, and the faster application process further enhances productivity.

4. Superior Finish and Aesthetic Appeal

Powder coating delivers a smooth, uniform finish without drips or sags. Its wide range of colors and textures allows for greater design flexibility, ensuring products look flawless.

5. Health and Safety Benefits

Powder coatings are non-toxic and solvent-free, eliminating harmful fumes during application. This ensures a safer working environment for operators.

6. Enhanced Performance Characteristics

Powder coatings excel in resisting chemicals, corrosion, and UV radiation. These qualities make them ideal for outdoor use and products exposed to harsh environments.

7. Easy Maintenance

Powder-coated surfaces are easy to clean and require no special maintenance. A quick wipe with a damp cloth keeps them looking new.

8. Consistency in Application

The electrostatic application process ensures an even coating, even on complex shapes. This level of consistency is difficult to achieve with liquid painting.

9. Faster Curing Times

Powder coatings cure faster than liquid paints, reducing downtime and increasing productivity in high-volume production environments.

10. Energy Efficiency

Powder coatings require less energy to cure due to lower temperatures and shorter durations, leading to energy savings and reduced operational costs.

Is Powder Coating Better Than Painting?

Absolutely! Compared to traditional painting, powder coating offers a more efficient, durable, and environmentally friendly solution. The absence of solvents and the ability to recycle overspray make it a smarter, more sustainable choice.

What Is the Difference Between Powder Coating and Liquid Painting?

  • Composition: Powder coatings are solvent-free, while liquid paints contain significant amounts of solvents and VOCs.
  • Application Process: Powder coating uses an electrostatic process for a uniform finish, whereas liquid painting may result in drips or uneven application.
  • Durability: Powder coatings are tougher and more resistant to environmental wear.
  • Environmental Impact: Powder coating is eco-friendly with negligible VOC emissions.

Conclusion: The Future of Coating Solutions

Choosing powder coating over liquid painting offers numerous advantages, from superior durability to eco-friendliness and cost-efficiency. At Value Added Coating Solution Private Limited, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge powder coating solutions tailored to your needs. For more information about our products and services, visit our website or contact us directly. Experience the unmatched benefits of superior powder coating technology with us today!

What is Powder Coating

Powder coating is a high-level strategy for applying embellishing and defensive completion to a broad scope of materials and items utilized by the two businesses and purchasers. The powder used for the cycle is a combination of finely ground particles of color and gum. It is showered onto a surface to be covered. The powder particles have a charge and they stick to the electrically grounded surfaces until warmed and melded into a smooth covered in a stove. The outcome is a uniform, robust and top-caliber, What's more, appealing completion.

What is Pre-treatment for Powder coating

Pre-treatment is the chemical preparation method of various types of metal and aluminum. It is used before applying a powder-coated surface finish. In all powder coating systems, appropriate surface pre-treatment is necessary to ensure long-lasting results. In industries where there is the creation of steel projecting, aluminum expulsions, steel production and so on material goes through high temperatures of intensity to accomplish the beneficial shape and sizes. Often steel material during machining works additionally goes through a progression of machines for cutting, crushing, and so forth. Sheet metal parts go through cutting and different bowing machines.

Pretreatment Processes

Whether you are new or predictable at preparing surfaces, you realize that the cleaner stage is the most important and fundamental stage in preparing any substrate. Cleaning is what each stage depends on, including effective powder application. The accompanying pretreatment arrangements just won't work as expected on the off chance that this isn't done as expected. You need to construct a consistent cycle in view of the item you're utilizing.

Pretreatment System

It comprises tanks or tubs containing synthetic compounds or water. In it, the articles are plunged to clean and set up the surface for powder covering. The size of the tanks or tubs relies upon the size and amount of articles to be covered. The specific interaction relies upon the metal make-up of the article.

Powder Spray framework

It is the powder covering machine or powder coating system. It is the heart or primary piece of the powder splash framework utilized in this interaction. This splashes electrostatically charged powder into the shower stall where the articles covered are hanging. Electrostatic powers give a specific and steady covering quality.

Relieving stove

In a relieving stove, powder-covered articles are put for 10 to 15 minutes. It is at the upgraded temperature for the powder to liquefy, polymerize, wire, and fix into the last completion of high tasteful allure with specific mechanical and substance properties.

Some Types of Powder Coating

Three primary sorts of powder coatings:
  1. Thermosets powder coatings
  2. thermoplastics powder coatings
  3. UV treatable powder coatings.
Thermoset powder coatings incorporate a cross-linker into the plan. Most normal cross-linkers are strong epoxy saps so exceptionally known as half-breed powders. The substance cross-connecting for crossovers addresses a significant piece of the worldwide powder covering market. In the powder covering industry, utilizing catalysts is normal. Here, 10-15% of the dynamic fixing is brought into a polyester transporter pitch as a lattice. This gives the most ideal even scattering of a modest quantity of an impetus over the haul of the powder. Thermosetting powder coatings liquefy when presented to warm, yet they are synthetically cross-connected inside themselves. Thermoplastic powders, don't change back to the fluid stage when warmed. UV-treatable powder coatings are photopolymerisable materials. They contain a compound that immediately answers UV light energy. It starts the response that prompts crosslinking. The remarkable component of this cycle from others is the partition of the dissolving stage before the restoring stage. The UV-restored powder will liquefy in 60 to 120 seconds when temperatures reach 110 °C and 130 °C. While softened covering is in this temperature window, it is in a split second relieved when presented to UV light.

Powder Coating Market and Its Application

Today, powder covering materials are accessible in each tone and an assortment of surfaces and gleams. Powder coatings have numerous applications in hundred of kinds of parts and items, including all-metal porch furniture and most metal showcase racks, store and shop apparatuses. Wire-shaped items, for example, springs and capacity bins for use in home and office are much of powder instead of liquid. For thermosetting powders, the appliance industry is the greatest single market area. Thermosetting powder materials give even, slight movies with elevated degrees of protection from chips, effects, cleansers, and synthetic compounds. It means quite a bit to the apparatus business. Applications incorporate fridges, dryer drums, range lodgings, dishwashers, microwave pits, cooler cupboards, outside cooling units and paint shop, etc. Powder coating systems also play important role in automotive applications. For example, there are many parts of vehicles that are of powder coating materials. These parts like wheels, door handles, engine blocks, and many other parts are it it. It is used in many lawn and garden equipment. This system of powder coating is also used in sporting products. So this method of coating is quite good. Now this is the coating industry future. We should also think about our environment. SO we should use it where we can. There are so many items that are in you home and you don't know about its manufacturing. So as a business man you should know your industry and use the best machine and method. The machinery are little bit costly but too much effective.
